    noncomputable def EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.boundedShiftHomEquiv (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P Q : TwoTerm R) (n : ℤ) :
    (P.inBoundedProjectives ⟶ (CategoryTheory.shiftFunctor (boundedProjective R).FullSubcategory n).obj Q.inBoundedProjectives) ≃ₗ[k] P.homotopyObject ⟶ (CategoryTheory.shiftFunctor (HomotopyCategory (FGModuleCat R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) n).obj Q.homotopyObject

    Passing to the full bounded-projective category preserves the vector space of maps into each shift.
